---
name: Content suggestion
about: Add a paper, tool, dataset, course, or correct/refresh a link
title: "[content] "
labels: content
---

**What to add or change?**
The paper / tool / dataset / course, and which reference file or skill it belongs
in (e.g., `references/recon-methods.md`, `diffusion-mri`).

**Primary source (verified link)**
A resolvable URL — the repo, DOI, or arXiv id. Please confirm it loads.

**Why it belongs here**
One or two lines: what it is and when someone would reach for it. Keep the
pointer-not-dump philosophy (link and summarize; no bundled datasets or
copyrighted text).
